title: ZuodaoTech/everyone-can-use-english: an AI-supported English practice system
friendlyTitle: Everyone Can Use English combines lessons with an AI practice app
summary: This GPL-licensed TypeScript project combines the Chinese-language ‘Everyone Can Use English’ learning materials with Enjoy, an AI-assisted language-practice application. It has about 38,100 GitHub stars and gained roughly 436 stars in the day’s trending snapshot.
friendlySummary: The project offers Chinese-language English-learning material and an AI-assisted practice application. It has about 38,100 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Chinese-speaking learners can use the materials and app as a structured self-training path, while developers can study a mature language-learning product. Most documentation is in Chinese, and GPL obligations apply when redistributing modified versions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Learners can follow a structured practice path, and developers can study how the learning app is built. The main material is in Chinese.
